description: This Java source file defines the class NotesViewThemeUtils, which provides utility methods for theming and styling UI components in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes methods for coloring navigation items, theming toolbars, coloring drawables, and handling theme-related color calculations, often based on dynamic color schemes and dark mode detection.

classes.name: NotesViewThemeUtils
classes.description: A utility class for theming and styling UI components in the Nextcloud Notes Android client, providing methods for coloring navigation items, theming toolbars, coloring drawables, and handling theme-related color calculations.

methods.name: colorNavigationViewItem
methods.description: Colors a navigation view item with a background tint based on the current color scheme.

methods.name: colorNavigationViewItemIcon
methods.description: Colors the icon of a navigation view item based on the current color scheme.

methods.name: colorNavigationViewItemText
methods.description: Colors the text of a navigation view item based on the current color scheme.

methods.name: applyBrandToPrimaryToolbar
methods.description: Deprecated method to apply branding colors to a primary toolbar and app bar layout.

methods.name: colorLayerDrawable
methods.description: Colors a specific part of a LayerDrawable with a given color.

methods.name: getTextHighlightBackgroundColor
methods.description: Calculates an appropriate background color for text highlights based on theme and contrast considerations.

methods.name: themeSearchCardView
methods.description: Deprecated method to theme a search card view with the current color scheme.

methods.name: themeSearchToolbar
methods.description: Deprecated method to theme a toolbar for search functionality.
